info.title: Tiducto Transit API — Stops
info.description: Stop text and geo search, key-authenticated. Companion to routing and realtime; the three share one pack version. A member that has no value is absent, never null. `locationType` is a closed set (`0`, `1`); `wheelchairBoarding` is the feed's GTFS integer code, and an unrecognised code passes through unchanged. A path that matches no operation, and every path of an environment without a stop-search deployment, is the gateway's plain-text `404 Not Found`, outside every operation.

servers.description: Your environment. Replace `{env-slug}` with your environment's slug.

post.description:
Stop text and geo search over the environment's stops, a station's platforms folded into it.
- `POST` only; another method is a 405 `method_not_allowed`. Any query parameter is a 400 `<name> is not allowed`.
- The body takes `q` and `limit` (1 to 50), and optionally `filter` and `sort`. A key not listed is refused whatever its value, null included; `null` on an optional member means absent. Nothing is clamped.
- `sort` orders by distance with `_geoPoint(lat, lng):asc` or `:desc`; each hit then carries `_geoDistance` in metres.
- A `filter` or `sort` expression the index refuses is a 400 `filter is invalid` or `sort is invalid`.
- A member that has no value is absent from a hit, never null.

400.description: A missing, malformed, out-of-range or unknown member, or a `filter` or `sort` expression the index refuses; `field` names it. Nothing is clamped. A body that is empty, not JSON or not an object is `body is invalid` with no `field`. Any query parameter is `<name> is not allowed`, `field` naming it.

401.description: The `apikey` header is missing (`key_missing`) or holds no valid key (`key_invalid`).

403.description: The key is not allowed on this operation (`key_not_allowed`), or the agreement it belongs to is inactive (`agreement_inactive`).

429.description: The key's rate limit is reached (`rate_limited`).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is admitted again.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make per rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix seconds at which the rate-limit window resets.

4XX.description: Another client error: 404 `not_found`, 405 `method_not_allowed`, 411 `length_required` (a body without a length) or 413 `payload_too_large`.

5XX.description: From Spider, an ErrorResponse: `internal_error`, `upstream_unavailable` or `upstream_timeout`. A network intermediary in front of Spider may answer a 5XX with a body that is not JSON.

apikey.name: apikey
apikey.description: The raw key in an `apikey` header (not Authorization: Bearer).

StopSearchRequest.description: POST body for `/stops/v1/search`, at most 64 KiB (a larger body is a 413). The body accepts only `q`, `filter`, `sort` and `limit`; any other key is a 400 `<key> is not allowed`, whatever its value, null included. A body that is empty, not JSON or not an object is a 400 `body is invalid`. `null` on an optional member means absent, and on a required member is a 400 `<key> is required`. `filter` and `sort` are search-index expressions the client composes (not modeled shapes); an expression the index refuses is a 400 `filter is invalid` or `sort is invalid` naming it.

q.description: Search text, matched against the stop's `name`, its `code`, its town (`city`) and the district within the town (`suburb`); town and district only where the environment has them. An empty string matches every stop. Another type is a 400 `q is invalid`.

filter.description: A filter expression: conditions `attribute OPERATOR value` combined with `AND`, `OR` and `NOT`, read left to right, grouped with parentheses. Operators: `=`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `low TO high` (an inclusive range), `IN [a, b]`, `EXISTS`, `IS NULL` and `IS EMPTY`, the last four negatable with `NOT` (`NOT IN`, `NOT EXISTS`, `IS NOT NULL`, `IS NOT EMPTY`). A value with whitespace, or one that reads as an operator, is quoted with `'` or `"`. Geo conditions: `_geoRadius(lat, lng, metres)`, `_geoBoundingBox([northLat, eastLng], [southLat, westLng])` and `_geoPolygon([lat, lng], [lat, lng], [lat, lng], ...)` (three or more vertices). Filterable attributes: `gtfsId`, the admin levels (`country`, `region`, `district`, `city`, `suburb`), `locationType`, `wheelchairBoarding`, `modes` and `_geo` (the stop's position). Examples: `city = "Brno"`, `gtfsId = "1:39822"`, `locationType = 1` (stations), `locationType != 1` (everything else, stops that omit the field included), `wheelchairBoarding = 1`, `modes = RAIL` (stops a rail route serves), `_geoRadius(49.1951, 16.6068, 500)`. An attribute that isn't filterable or a malformed expression is a 400 `filter is invalid`; filtering on an admin level the environment wasn't enriched with matches no stops. A filter array or another type is a 400 `filter is invalid`.

sort.description: Sort expressions. The one sortable attribute is the stop's position: `_geoPoint(lat, lng):asc` orders by distance from that point, nearest first, and `:desc` farthest first; each hit then carries `_geoDistance`. Any other expression is a 400 `sort is invalid`. Absent orders by relevance.

limit.description: Max hits to return, an integer from 1 to 50. Missing is a 400 `limit is required`, not an integer `limit is invalid`, outside 1 to 50 `limit is out of range`; rejected, never clamped.

StopSearchResponse.description: Search hits. The body can carry further members not listed here; they aren't part of the contract and may change or disappear.

StopHit.description: One stop. A station's platforms are folded into it, so the station is returned instead of its platforms. Admin levels are present only where the deployment enriched them; the other optional members are absent when the feed doesn't provide them. A hit can carry further members not listed here; they aren't part of the contract and may change or disappear.

gtfsId.description: Feed-prefixed stop id (`<feedId>:<id>`), the same id routing's `gtfsId` carries.

code.description: Short public code riders know the stop by, as the feed gives it (GTFS `stop_code`), e.g. the one printed on its sign.

locationType.description: GTFS `location_type`: `0` a stop or platform, `1` a station (its platforms folded into it). Absent when the feed doesn't set it, which means a stop. No other values are returned.

wheelchairBoarding.description: GTFS `wheelchair_boarding`: `1` some vehicles here can be boarded by a rider in a wheelchair, `2` wheelchair boarding isn't possible here, `0` no information. A station's value is the station's own; its platforms' values aren't combined into it. Absent when the feed doesn't set it, which also means no information. Any other value is passed through from the feed unchanged.

modes.description: Modes of the routes serving the stop, each once, sorted: the mode names routing returns for those routes (e.g. `BUS`, `TRAM`, `RAIL`). A station's modes cover all its platforms. Absent when no route serves the stop.

_geoDistance.description: Metres from the `_geoPoint` the request sorts by; present only when it sorts by `_geoPoint`.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body: a stable machine-readable `code`, which names a state, and a human-readable `message`.

code.description: One of `bad_request`, `key_missing`, `key_invalid`, `key_not_allowed`, `agreement_inactive`, `planning_limit_reached`, `not_found`, `method_not_allowed`, `length_required`, `payload_too_large`, `rate_limited`, `internal_error`, `upstream_unavailable`, `upstream_timeout`. New codes may be added.

message.description: For `bad_request`: `<field> is required|invalid|out of range|not allowed`, or `body is invalid` when the body is empty, not JSON or not an object.

field.description: Present only on a 400 that names one member: its dot path from the body root, array positions omitted, or the query parameter's name.
